**1. Support Reactions:**
Let the cantilever beam be fixed at point $A$ (left end) and free at point $B$ (right end) with length $L = 5\text{ m}$.
- Distributed load $w = 2\text{ kN/m}$ over length $5\text{ m}$. Total UDL load $= 2 \times 5 = 10\text{ kN}$ acting at the center ($2.5\text{ m}$ from $A$).
- Point load at free end $W = 4\text{ kN}$.

Vertical reaction at fixed support ($R_A$):
$$R_A = \text{Total downward loads} = (2 \times 5) + 4 = 10 + 4 = 14\text{ kN}$$

Bending moment at fixed support ($M_A$):
$$M_A = - \left( (2 \times 5) \times \frac{5}{2} + 4 \times 5 \right) = - (10 \times 2.5 + 20) = - (25 + 20) = -45\text{ kN}\,\text{m}$$

**2. Shear Force (S.F.) Calculations:**
- At free end ($x = 0$): $\text{S.F.} = -4\text{ kN}$
- Just before fixed end ($x = 5\text{ m}$): $\text{S.F.} = -4 - (2 \times 5) = -14\text{ kN}$
- The shear force varies linearly between $B$ and $A$.

**3. Bending Moment (B.M.) Calculations:**
- At free end ($x = 0$): $\text{B.M.} = 0\text{ kN}\,\text{m}$
- At fixed end ($x = 5\text{ m}$): $\text{B.M.} = -4(5) - 2(5)\left(\frac{5}{2}\right) = -20 - 25 = -45\text{ kN}\,\text{m}$
- The bending moment varies parabolically along the span.
proTip: For a cantilever beam with UDL and point load, the bending moment diagram consists of a combined parabolic and linear curve.
